+## What
+`Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Streaming/ParagraphReuseTests.swift` `aChunkThatSettlesAParagraphEvaluatesOnlyTheNewParagraph(isLazy:)` fails at commit `d47abd7` with no working tree change, for both arguments (`isLazy` true and false). The assertion `BodyEvaluationCounter.count(firstKey) == 0` ("The settled paragraph evaluated again.") fails. The test fails alone (`swift test --filter ParagraphReuseTests`) and in the full suite. Found during ^bgffcf1; that task does not change the streaming views.
+
+- [ ] Find why the settled paragraph view evaluates again when a chunk settles the next paragraph.
+- [ ] Correct the view or the test, so that the settled paragraph does not evaluate again.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift test --filter ParagraphReuseTests` passes.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
